text: Svalbard is an archipelago in the Arctic Ocean, of which Norway has sovereignty over. As such, Svalbard is counted as **Norway** for country streaks purposes.
text_zh: 斯瓦貝爾（Svalbard）是北極海中的一個群島，由挪威擁有主權。因此，就國家連勝（country streaks）的計算而言，斯瓦貝爾被視為**挪威**。

text: Licence plates in Svalbard are generally **black** with **yellow text**.
text_zh: 斯瓦巴的車牌通常是 **黑色** 配 **黃色字**。

text: The general landscape consists of **barren, treeless** mountains. Trees and greenery are a very rare sight, with the majority of vegetation consisting of moss and grasses. The sky is also often overcast, with a gloomy look to the coverage.
text_zh: 整體景觀由 **荒涼、無樹** 的山脈組成。樹木和綠意非常罕見，大部分的植被由苔蘚和草組成。天空也經常陰沉，街景覆蓋呈現陰暗的外觀。

text: **Russian** can sometimes be found on signs.
text_zh: 有時可以在標誌上找到**俄語**。

text: Longyearbyen is the largest settlement on Svalbard, with many **boxy, minimalistic **buildings around the town.
text_zh: 朗伊爾城（Longyearbyen）是斯瓦巴最大的聚落，鎮上有許多 **方正、極簡** 風格的建築。

text: Pyramiden feels more abandoned compared to Longyearbyen. Multi-storey **soviet-style** apartment blocks can be seen, however, with a lack of human-activity. As the name suggests, many [pyramidal](https://goo.gl/maps/BwYf7hXdrqow9e3S6) mountains can be seen in the distance.
text_zh: 與朗伊爾城相比，皮拉米登給人一種更荒涼的感覺。可以看到多層的**蘇聯風格**公寓大樓，但缺乏人類活動的跡象。正如其名，在遠處可以看到許多[金字塔形](https://goo.gl/maps/BwYf7hXdrqow9e3S6)的山脈。

text: Of the three towns, Barentsburg feels the most desolate. Distinct, **multi-coloured** apartment blocks can be seen near the top of the hill. Coverage is also more overcast and gloomy than Longyearbyen or Pyramiden.
text_zh: 在這三個城鎮中，巴倫斯堡（Barentsburg）感覺最為荒涼。在山丘頂部附近可以看到特有的**多色**公寓大樓。與朗伊爾城（Longyearbyen）或皮拉米金（Pyramiden）相比，這裡的街景覆蓋也更加陰沉昏暗。

text: This road going south-east of Longyearbyen can be recognized by the barren, treeless **mountains** on both sides of the road, with **lakes** leading up to the mountains. A small black mirror can sometimes be seen on the left.
text_zh: 這條從 Longyearbyen 東南方延伸的道路，其特徵是道路兩側皆為荒涼、無樹的**山脈**，且有**湖泊**一路綿延至山腳下。左側有時可以看到一面小黑鏡。

text: A trekker can be seen holding on to a **red car** heading up a winding road, south of the Svalbard Airport. If the car is not present, this distinct [line of mountains](https://goo.gl/maps/Aub5RxFwVD9QruVz9) to the northeast is a good indicator that you are there.
text_zh: 在斯瓦爾巴機場南方，可以看到一台徒步拍攝相機正抓著一台開往蜿蜒山路的**紅色車**。如果沒有看到車子，東北方這個明顯的[山脈稜線](https://goo.gl/maps/Aub5RxFwVD9QruVz9)會是判斷你身處該處的好指標。

text: This **large ship** can be seen around the Northwest Spitsbergen National Park. The coverage gets increasingly late toward the east, where it eventually becomes [dark](https://goo.gl/maps/5mYS6pc2bpQLMzS86).
text_zh: 這艘 **大型船隻** 可以在西北斯匹茲卑爾根國家公園（Northwest Spitsbergen National Park）一帶看到。街景覆蓋越往東越新，最後甚至變成了 [暗色](https://goo.gl/maps/5mYS6pc2bpQLMzS86)。

text: This boat with a **wooden deck** can be seen in these places.
text_zh: 這艘有著 **木質甲板** 的船可以在這些地方看到。

text: This **small red boat** with men in **red jackets** on board can be seen in the northwest.
text_zh: 這艘載著身穿 **紅色夾克** 的男子的 **小型紅船** 可以在西北部看到。

text: This boat with a **black deck** can be seen in Isfjorden, between Barentsburg and Grumant.
text_zh: 這艘有著 **黑色甲板** 的船可以在伊斯費尤德（Isfjorden），也就是巴倫支堡（Barentsburg）和格魯曼特（Grumant）之間看到。

text: This boat can be seen east of Pyramiden, and can be identified by the **slanted front of the wheelhouse**.
text_zh: 這艘船可以在皮拉米登（Pyramiden）以東看到，可以透過 **傾斜的駕駛室正面** 來識別。
